name: Left 4 Dead 2
description: Co-op zombie survival for 4 (or 8 in versus) players. SRCDS dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: Start map
variables.description: e.g. c1m1_hotel (Dead Center), c2m1_highway (Dark Carnival), c5m1_waterfront (The Parish).

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Enables console commands via Source RCON (on the game port) when set. Leave empty to disable RCON.

notes: A basic left4dead2/cfg/server.cfg is written at install; edit it in the file manager for more settings (sv_password, rcon_password, sv_steamgroup). Windows hosts: set the start command override to srcds.exe -game left4dead2 with the same arguments.
